page.layout: Top: two boxed entry columns (left and right) above a horizontal rule. Below the rule: two columns of entries, left column then right column. Page number at top left. Running head at top, Hebrew "ש א" over the left column and "ש ב" over the right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: f. peh. רִשַׁם exaratum, part. præt. peh. Rad. רשם.
main_text.head: ש א
main_text.l: שְׂאָ sumito, Imper. peh. R. נשא.
שָׁאַל petiit, שְׁאֵלְנָא interrogavimus, præt. שָׁאַל petens, part. præf. peh.
שְׁאֵלָתָה petitio, No. f. f. emph. R. שאל.
שְׁאָר reliqui, שְׁאָרָא residuum, No. f. abl. emph. R. שארא.
שְׁבַחְתִּי laudasti, שִׁבַּחְתִּי laudavi, שִׁבְּחוּ laudârunt, præt. pah. R. שבח.
שְׁבִיבָא scintilla, שְׁבִיבִין scintillæ, No. f. emph. & pl. R. שבב.
שָׁבְטֵי tribus, No. pl. constr. R. שבט.
שֵׁבִי seniores, No. pl. constr. & emph. R. שוב.
שִׁבְעָה septem, No. m. & constr. R. שבע.
שִׁבְקוּ finite, Imper. peh. R. שבק.
שַׂגִּיא multus, multum, vehementer, שַׂגִּיאִין ampla, No. m. f. quod etiam adverbiascit, & pl. f. R. שגא.
שִׁגַּלְתָּךְ uxores ejus, שִׁגַּלְתֵּה tuæ, No. pl. f. aff. R. שגל.
שְׁהֵדוּתָא testimonium, No. f. f. emph. R. שהר.
שְׁוִי posuit, præt. pah. R. שוה.
שׁוּרְיָא muri, No. pl. emph. etiam cum ה præter ordinem, R. שור.
שִׁיב eripuit, præt. pah. liberare nos, לְשִׁיזְבוּתָנָא te, לְשִׁיזְבוּתָךְ eum, Inf. pah. aff. R. שזב.

page.notes: Hebrew and the Latin in the entries are copied as far as legible; the vowel points and Hebrew forms in the dense entries (especially the top boxes and the entries with "שִׁגַּלְתָּךְ", "שִׁיב", "שִׁבְקוּ") are doubtful and not verified letter by letter. The page number "56" and the running head "ש א / ש ב" are uncertain at this scan resolution. The top boxed entries, the heading "ש א" and the catchword are transcribed as printed but may contain errors. Latin in the entries is copied, with long s as s.
